<role>
You check one property (faithfulness) of a product-feedback opportunity for Keelwater, a claims-handling software company. You do not rewrite anything.
</role>
<definition>
Question: is every claim in the brief supported by the cited evidence and the fact sheet, with nothing overstated and no cited contrary evidence left out? Pass means yes.
Fail on an uncited claim, a number that is off the fact sheet, a scope wider than the cited accounts, a paraphrase placed in quotation marks, or an ignored contrary citation.
The evidence is the brief, the cited insights and the fact sheet (accounts, ARR, mentions, routes, renewals).
</definition>

 "brief": "## Problem\nCustomers cannot correct the purchase order number on invoices generated by Keelwater's claims-handling software. This mismatch with their internal records blocks payment cycles and creates reconciliation challenges for finance teams.\n\n## Who is affected\n- 4 accounts have reported this issue [i:1e3a49d688ebbadd][i:73f973717c225729][i:99ed668a91f6c801][i:f7561e6a446002ad].\n- The problem has been raised through 2 routes: support and sales [i:1e3a49d688ebbadd][i:73f973717c225729][i:99ed668a91f6c801][i:f7561e6a446002ad].\n\n## Evidence\n- There have been 4 mentions of this problem across the 4 accounts [i:1e3a49d688ebbadd][i:73f973717c225729][i:99ed668a91f6c801][i:f7561e6a446002ad].\n- 3 mentions came through the support route [i:1e3a49d688ebbadd][i:73f973717c225729][i:99ed668a91f6c801].\n- 1 mention came through the sales route [i:f7561e6a446002ad].\n- The total Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) from these accounts is £2,442,000.0 [i:1e3a49d688ebbadd][i:73f973717c225729][i:99ed668a91f6c801][i:f7561e6a446002ad].\n- Greystock Liability reported, I’m trying to get our purchase order number updated on your latest invoice — it’s currently wrong... [i:1e3a49d688ebbadd].\n- Penhallow Specialty Risks reported, I’m reaching out because we need to update the purchase order reference on our most recent invoice — it’s causing reconciliation issues with our finance team. [i:73f973717c225729].\n- Elderfold Home reported, I’m writing to request an update to the purchase order number on your invoice — this is causing reconciliation issues, and I need the invoice contact change reflected accurately in our records. [i:99ed668a91f6c801].\n- Wexmoor Motor reported, The PO we referenced doesn’t match what’s on your billing, and it’s blocking our payment cycle. [i:f7561e6a446002ad].\n\n## Why now\n- 2 of the affected accounts have renewals due within the next 90 days [i:1e3a49d688ebbadd][i:99ed668a91f6c801].\n- Greystock Liability has a renewal date of 2027-01-25 [i:1e3a49d688ebbadd].\n- Elderfold Home has a renewal date of 2026-12-21 [i:99ed668a91f6c801].\n- The most recent report was made on 2026-10-30 [i:f7561e6a446002ad].\n- The problem is actively blocking payment cycles for at least one account [i:f7561e6a446002ad].",

response.content: {"critique": "I checked all quantitative claims against the fact sheet: 4 accounts, 4 mentions, 2 routes (3 support, 1 sales), ARR of £2,442,000.0, and 2 renewals within 90 days (Greystock Liability 2027-01-25 and Elderfold Home 2026-12-21, both within 90 days of the 2026-11-03 as-of date) — all match.
